The '''Yarin Harbormaster''' worked on the [[Crystal Reef]] resort on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. He was responsible for leasing submersibles and other watercraft to the tourists there. He loaned his personal craft, ''[[Elfa]]'', to the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Cilghal]] in [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]].
